summary: Strengthen negotiation plans, contract controls and claims records for oil and gas work. Review the course outline and see how it fits your role.
lede: Energy contract negotiation and management involves shaping commercial terms and controlling obligations from tendering through close-out. For contract managers, administrators and commercial professionals, the work includes comparing bids, preparing negotiation positions, tracking notices and amendments, and assessing variations or claims. The course covers risk allocation, pricing and change assessment, maintaining obligations and claims records, and reporting performance and commercial exposure, using the EPC/Turnkey Contract 2nd Ed (2017 Silver Book) as a reference.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare, negotiate or administer oil and gas agreements and need to coordinate commercial decisions with project delivery teams.
prerequisites: Working experience with commercial contracts, tendering or contract administration is expected. No coding or programming is required.
